CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditEntry" (
  "actorId" text,
  "actorKind" text NOT NULL,
  "details" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "occurredAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "severity" text NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "AuditEntry_actorKind_check_eb9fa190" CHECK ("actorKind" IN ('MEMBER', 'VISITOR', 'SYSTEM')),
  CONSTRAINT "AuditEntry_details_rule_e50db189" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("details") = 'object'),
  CONSTRAINT "AuditEntry_label_rule_678d1d4c" CHECK (char_length("source") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND char_length("type") BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  CONSTRAINT "AuditEntry_member_actor_check_98aa2b3c" CHECK (("actorKind" = 'MEMBER') = ("actorId" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "AuditEntry_severity_check_f199a339" CHECK ("severity" IN ('INFO', 'WARN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BookableResource" (
  "assignedActorId" text,
  "availability" jsonb,
  "capacity" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text,
  "managerChange" jsonb,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "skills" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableResource_actor_rule_e8fa4523" CHECK ("assignedActorId" IS NULL OR char_length("assignedActorId") BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableResource_capacity_rule_d4b0b053" CHECK ("capacity" IS NULL OR "capacity" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableResource_name_rule_38e74a36" CHECK (char_length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableResource_skills_rule_581142a0" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("skills") = 'array'),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableResource_type_check_8d6e2feb" CHECK ("type" IN ('employee', 'room', 'office', 'service-desk', 'sports-field', 'meeting-room', 'vehicle', 'equipment', 'facility', 'workstation', 'other'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BookableService" (
  "availability" jsonb,
  "cancellation" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "category" text,
  "cleanupMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "durationMinutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "horizonDays" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "information" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "instructions" text,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "locationIds" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "noticeMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "participantsPerBooking" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "participantsPerSession" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "preparationMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "requiredDocuments" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "requirements" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "rescheduling" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "slotIntervalMinutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_buffers_rule_53109094" CHECK ("preparationMinutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 240 AND "cleanupMinutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 240),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_category_rule_e6f05208" CHECK ("category" IS NULL OR char_length("category") <= 64),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_description_rule_c341d9ba" CHECK ("description" IS NULL OR char_length("description") <= 2000),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_instructions_rule_7941d6d7" CHECK ("instructions" IS NULL OR char_length("instructions") <= 2000),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_lists_rule_8a614c43" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("locationIds") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("requirements") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("information") = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("requiredDocuments") = 'array'),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_name_rule_38e74a36" CHECK (char_length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_participants_rule_e342c26a" CHECK ("participantsPerBooking" BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "participantsPerSession" BETWEEN "participantsPerBooking" AND 500),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_rules_rule_68aba18c" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("cancellation") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("rescheduling") = 'object'),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_timing_rule_998915e5" CHECK ("durationMinutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 1440 AND "slotIntervalMinutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 240),
  CONSTRAINT "BookableService_window_rule_0c76c76e" CHECK ("noticeMinutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 525600 AND "horizonDays" BETWEEN 1 AND 730)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Booking" (
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "cancelledBy" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer" jsonb,
  "customerEmail" text,
  "end" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "holdExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "locationId" text NOT NULL,
  "occupiedEnd" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "occupiedStart" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "participants" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "rescheduleCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "serviceId" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionCapacity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sessionKey" text NOT NULL,
  "start" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_cancelled_rule_2f2cfb7b" CHECK (("status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("cancelledAt" IS NOT NULL AND "cancelledBy" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_customer_known_rule_47752ebc" CHECK ("status" NOT IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW') OR "customer" IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_customer_rule_4b39e918" CHECK ("customer" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("customer") = 'object'),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_group_size_rule_69eea88d" CHECK ("participants" >= 1 AND "participants" <= "sessionCapacity"),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_reference_rule_1ba81916" CHECK ("reference" ~ '^[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10}$'),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_reschedules_rule_e98165eb" CHECK ("rescheduleCount" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_span_check_956c7fbe" CHECK ("start" < "end" AND "occupiedStart" <= "start" AND "end" <= "occupiedEnd"),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_status_check_db2290c3" CHECK ("status" IN ('HELD', 'CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'NO_SHOW', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BookingLocation" (
  "address" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "openingHours" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "staffHours" jsonb,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "timeZone" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "BookingLocation_address_rule_1bffa6f4" CHECK ("address" IS NULL OR char_length("address") <= 300),
  CONSTRAINT "BookingLocation_hours_rule_14882546" CHECK (jsonb_typeof("openingHours") = 'object' AND ("staffHours" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("staffHours") = 'object')),
  CONSTRAINT "BookingLocation_name_rule_38e74a36" CHECK (char_length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  CONSTRAINT "BookingLocation_zone_rule_9089714f" CHECK (char_length("timeZone") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BookingResource" (
  "bookingId" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool NOT NULL,
  "occupiedEnd" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "occupiedStart" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "resourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionKey" text NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("bookingId", "resourceId"),
  CONSTRAINT "BookingResource_span_check_62352ed1" CHECK ("occupiedStart" < "occupiedEnd")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DataSource" (
  "config" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "lastCheckedAt" timestamptz,
  "lastError" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "DataSource_kind_check_c3ae767f" CHECK ("kind" IN ('MOCK', 'REST')),
  CONSTRAINT "DataSource_name_rule_ec45dfca" CHECK (char_length("name") BETWEEN 2 AND 100),
  CONSTRAINT "DataSource_status_check_ff3434bd" CHECK ("status" IN ('UNKNOWN', 'OK', 'ERROR'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Dataset" (
  "canonicalKind" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dataSourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastFetchedAt" timestamptz,
  "mapping" jsonb,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "path" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Dataset_kind_rule_50c206e9" CHECK (char_length("canonicalKind") BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
  CONSTRAINT "Dataset_name_rule_ec45dfca" CHECK (char_length("name") BETWEEN 2 AND 100),
  CONSTRAINT "Dataset_path_rule_784264d8" CHECK ("path" IS NULL OR ("path" LIKE '/%' AND "path" NOT LIKE '//%' AND char_length("path") <= 500)),
  CONSTRAINT "Dataset_slug_rule_5079bb33" CHECK ("slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9-]+$' AND char_length("slug") <= 50),
  CONSTRAINT "Dataset_status_check_ff3434bd" CHECK ("status" IN ('UNKNOWN', 'OK', 'ERROR'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Invitation" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invitedBy" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Invitation_email_rule_b834da03" CHECK (char_length("email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254),
  CONSTRAINT "Invitation_platform_rule_ff43ec02" CHECK (("role" = 'platform_admin') = ("tenantId" = 'platform')),
  CONSTRAINT "Invitation_role_check_62bd3a39" CHECK ("role" IN ('admin', 'editor', 'contributor', 'viewer', 'employee', 'platform_admin')),
  CONSTRAINT "Invitation_tenant_rule_0516ac63" CHECK ("tenantId" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'),
  CONSTRAINT "Invitation_token_rule_eadbb071" CHECK ("tokenHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Membership" (
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Membership_actor_rule_98c52012" CHECK (char_length("actorId") BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  CONSTRAINT "Membership_platform_rule_ff43ec02" CHECK (("role" = 'platform_admin') = ("tenantId" = 'platform')),
  CONSTRAINT "Membership_role_check_62bd3a39" CHECK ("role" IN ('admin', 'editor', 'contributor', 'viewer', 'employee', 'platform_admin')),
  CONSTRAINT "Membership_tenant_rule_0516ac63" CHECK ("tenantId" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Page" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "path" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Page_path_rule_8813a6c7" CHECK (("path" = '' OR "path" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*(/[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)*$') AND char_length("path") <= 200),
  CONSTRAINT "Page_title_rule_9831bb81" CHECK (char_length("title") BETWEEN 2 AND 120),
  CONSTRAINT "Page_version_rule_efd86c31" CHECK ("version" >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PageConfig" (
  "content" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "pageId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "PageConfig_status_check_1b4a7b6b" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED')),
  CONSTRAINT "PageConfig_version_rule_efd86c31" CHECK ("version" >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Website" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "publishedReleaseId" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "templateKey" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Website_description_rule_e354da0e" CHECK ("description" IS NULL OR char_length("description") <= 500),
  CONSTRAINT "Website_name_rule_ccdd0785" CHECK (char_length("name") BETWEEN 2 AND 120),
  CONSTRAINT "Website_slug_rule_ead2f3ca" CHECK ("slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' AND char_length("slug") <= 80),
  CONSTRAINT "Website_template_rule_3c5a908f" CHECK (char_length("templateKey") BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
  CONSTRAINT "Website_tenant_is_website_check_34a4fea9" CHECK ("id" = "tenantId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WebsiteMigration" (
  "appliedAt" timestamptz,
  "appliedBy" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "plan" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "proposedBy" text NOT NULL,
  "resolutions" jsonb,
  "sourceReleaseId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PROPOSED' NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteMigration_applied_rule_bd7c0272" CHECK (("status" = 'APPLIED') = ("appliedAt" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteMigration_status_check_953d0064" CHECK ("status" IN ('PROPOSED', 'APPLIED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WebsiteRelease" (
  "changes" jsonb,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "publishedBy" text,
  "releaseNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  "snapshot" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "snapshotHash" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteRelease_hash_rule_962e3d92" CHECK ("snapshotHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteRelease_note_rule_f768e023" CHECK ("note" IS NULL OR char_length("note") <= 200),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteRelease_number_rule_d77b088c" CHECK ("releaseNumber" >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteRelease_published_rule_d776d660" CHECK (("status" IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK')) = ("publishedAt" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteRelease_status_check_4475a53d" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'FAILED', 'ROLLED_BACK'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WebsiteTheme" (
  "accentColor" text DEFAULT '#C9782F' NOT NULL,
  "bodyFont" text DEFAULT 'Inter' NOT NULL,
  "headingFont" text DEFAULT 'Source Serif 4' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "primaryColor" text DEFAULT '#1F3A34' NOT NULL,
  "radius" text DEFAULT 'md' NOT NULL,
  "secondaryColor" text DEFAULT '#7A8B85' NOT NULL,
  "spacingScale" text DEFAULT 'comfortable' NOT NULL,
  "websiteId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "WebsiteTheme_colors_rule_d76d4915" CHECK ("primaryColor" ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$' AND "secondaryColor" ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$' AND "accentColor" ~ '^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$')
)

CREATE FUNCTION "public"."refuse_update"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION '% is append-only', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';
END
$$

CREATE FUNCTION "public"."freeze_release"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW."id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."id"
    OR NEW."websiteId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."websiteId"
    OR NEW."releaseNumber" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."releaseNumber"
    OR NEW."snapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."snapshot"
    OR NEW."snapshotHash" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."snapshotHash"
    OR NEW."note" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."note"
    OR NEW."changes" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."changes"
    OR NEW."publishedBy" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."publishedBy"
    OR NEW."createdAt" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."createdAt"
    OR (OLD."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND NEW."publishedAt" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."publishedAt") THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a release is immutable: only its status can change' USING ERRCODE = 'restrict_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$$
